stories.title: Saskatchewan recovery centre, accused of falsifying records, to be investigated by auditor
stories.summary: NDP health critic Meara Conway says the leaked records make it appear the EHN Willowview Recovery Centre could be falsifying the documents, which she says would be illegal.

stories.title: Alouettes place eight players on All-CFL team
stories.summary: Montreal Alouettes quarterback Davis Alexander and receivers Tyson Philpot and Tyler Snead earned All-CFL all-star honours Thursday.

stories.title: Saskatoon proposes 5.45% property tax increase in next year’s budget
stories.summary: City administrators are recommending that the council cut next year's budget by $1.19 million from the amount previously approved.

stories.title: Saskatoon potash company signs lease for new U.S. terminal, bypassing B.C.
stories.summary: The company -- based in Saskatoon -- says Longview emerged as its preferred site based on factors including location, logistics and capacity.

stories.title: A ‘long road’ lies ahead for Regina boy, 4, after alleged medical malpractice
stories.summary: The family of a Regina boy, 4, who needs a small intestine transplant alleges that it is the result of medical malpractice stemming from his appendicitis treatment in September.

stories.title: Saskatchewan RCMP make more than 100 arrests in ‘intelligence-driven enforcement’
stories.summary: A targeted enforcement blitz in Pelican Narrows, Sask., resulted in more than 100 arrests, as well as the seizure of 10 firearms and drugs, according to the RCMP.

stories.title: Canadian women’s flag football team to hold camp
stories.summary: It's back to work for Rachel Lessard and the Canadian women's flag football team.

stories.title: Saskatoon bus riders worry 10-minute rapid transit service promise is slipping
stories.summary: Saskatoon's transit director says 10-minute bus rapid transit service is not off the table as network redesign options show more infrequent service than previously promised.

stories.title: 7 bird flu cases across Prairies linked to Saskatchewan poultry show
stories.summary: Seven cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza have been detected in the Prairie provinces after an exposure at a Saskatchewan poultry show earlier this month.

stories.title: Mistrial declared in trial of former Saskatoon massage therapist
stories.summary: The courtroom filed with gasps and tears after hearing the declaration of a mistrial completely halting the jury trial for former massage therapist, Kenneth Braun.
